description: This file defines a React functional component named `Privacy`, which manages user privacy settings related to session user agent logging within a Preferences UI. It handles fetching, displaying, toggling, and updating the setting via application services, and includes UI elements like switches and descriptive text.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a user setting with the specified name and payload, handling errors and returning success status.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads user settings to initialize the component state, handling errors.

methods.name: toggleSessionLogging
methods.description: Toggles the session user agent logging setting and updates it via the application settings, reverting on failure.
